comment: Menus read from the maker's source at version 2.6.47, which is the installed version and also the head of main. Every Bogaudio module except ANALYZER-XL also carries a 'Panel' submenu (Default, Light, Dark, Dark (low-contrast), then 'Default to ...' entries that set the choice for the whole plugin, saved in Bogaudio.json in the Rack user directory). That item is identical on 110 modules and purely cosmetic, so it is not written into any entry; a person may want it added. The plugin ships no presets and no demo patches, so neither source was available for this pass.
